definitions.ask: When the link guard leaves a Project-blocked target unlinked, should the item's note bullets still land?
definitions.why: Notes don't depend on the link, and a guarded link is already a reported success

choices.label: Notes land; output says "not linked" and then lists the notes
The item fails before any write; notes land only with the link

definitions.ask: Should link-close forms (`@route:id=x…`, `^route:id=x…`) also take child bullets as task notes?
definitions.why: Under whole-item `x`, child bullets are Work Log entries, so link-close notes would read ambiguously

choices.label: Close forms keep refusing child bullets; only non-close link forms take notes
Close forms file bullets as notes before closing, unlike whole-item `x` Work Log bullets

definitions.ask: Should the implementer add a link-notes decision strand and mark capture-bullets-mirror-the-task-block superseded?
definitions.corrects: That position is a new task, a new project note, or a note-less `@route+id`

strands: Capture Bullets Mirror The Task Block
